question_record.context: Security incident involving a compromised user account with the account SID `S-0-6-5` delivering ransomware files. The alert was triggered due to the suspicious WMI process creation observed on the machine, which is possibly used by malware to spawn new processes.
question_record.question: There is also a suspicious WMI process creation related to this incident. Can you provide the command line details of the process observed?
solution: A user account was seen delivering ransomware-related files on host `vnevado-win11t`.
A suspicious WMI process was created with process ID `6280` at `2024-06-20t09:29:43.9198085z` using the command line `powershell -file c:\scripts\get-userprttoken.ps1`.

93.name: Possible compromised user account delivering ransomware-related files
93.description: A user account was observed dropping a ransomware-related file on several devices. An attacker may have compromised the said user account to move laterally across the network and infect as many devices with ransomware as possible. Automated remediation action may be taken to disable the account.

145.name: Suspicious WMI process creation
145.description: Suspicious WMI process creation was observed on the machine. Malware frequently use WMI to spawn new processes, breaking process trees and further infecting a machine.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_SID' AND o.Concept = 'Host_Name'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
parameters: Possible compromised user account delivering ransomware-related files
